draft.notice: Shared by every ElevenLabs line in this language. Your edits go to a draft that calls never hear until you press Save to live.
draft.liveMoved: The live {{lang}} prompt changed after this draft started. Save to live replaces that newer text (it is kept as a version in the history).
draft.liveMovedBoth: The live NL and EN prompts both changed after the drafts started. Save to live replaces those newer texts (they are kept as versions in the history).
draft.otherChanged: Also changed in {{lang}}: Save to live puts both languages live.
draft.missing: There is no ElevenLabs prompt in this language yet.
draft.noChanges: The draft is the same as live.
draft.saveConfirm: Put the drafts live in both languages (NL and EN)? Calls use them within 30 seconds. The current live texts are kept as versions.
draft.saved: Saved to live. Calls use it within 30 seconds.
draft.savedNone: Nothing to save: the drafts are the same as live.
draft.saveFailed: Could not save to live. Try again.
draft.discardConfirm: Discard the draft in both languages (NL and EN)? Accepted suggestions go back to the list. Live stays as it is.
draft.discarded: Draft discarded in both languages. The editor shows live again.
draft.discardFailed: Could not discard the draft. Try again.
draft.syncFailed: The draft could not be saved first. Nothing changed. Try again.

versions.restoreConfirm: Put v{{v}} in the draft? Live does not change until you save to live.
versions.restored: v{{v}} is in the draft now. Live does not change until you save to live.

review.title: Weekly review
review.help: Every Monday at 07:00 (Amsterdam time) the phone calls of the week before are reviewed. Run now reviews the last 7 days. The prompt changes it proposes show up as cards below.
review.running: Reviewing the calls. This takes a few minutes.
review.startFailed: Could not start the review. Try again.
review.loadFailed: Could not load the reviews. Try again later.
review.empty: No reviews yet. The first one runs on Monday, or press Run now.
review.failedUnknown: The review failed. Try again with Run now.
review.stalled: The review was cut off before it finished. Run it again with Run now.

cards.title: Suggested changes
cards.help: Each card changes one piece of the shared prompt. Accepting it puts the edit in the draft below. Nothing goes live until you press Save to live.

empty.open: No open changes. New ones come from the weekly review or from the coach.
empty.accepted: Nothing accepted yet. Accepted changes wait in the draft until you save to live.

cards.loadFailed: Could not load the changes. Try again later.
cards.inDraft: In the draft. It goes live with Save to live.
cards.stale: The text this card changes is no longer in the draft

note.decided: This change was already decided. The list is refreshed.
note.failed: That did not work. Try again.

common.loadFailed: Could not load the prompt. Try again later.
